name: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc.
business: AMC operates movie theatres in the United States and internationally, selling admissions, food and beverages to moviegoers.

events.what: No CEO, CFO or other executive appointment in window; only a director retirement (board shrinks 11 to 10) and an equity plan share increase
Incumbent CEO appointment (outside window, for tenure only)
events.from: Former CEO of Starwood Hotels and Resorts

next_event.source: Baba corpus search FY2026 (investor day, capital markets day): no hits

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Management frames the ambition as returning to pre-pandemic Adjusted EBITDA dollars (VA FY2019 EBITDA $771.4M), not as a margin level; no year attached. Earliest hit in corpus search: Q3 2024 call (doc 41781, Aron); call date not fetched. Repeats counted from search hits: Q3 2024 Aron, Q2 2025 Goodman, Q3 2025 Goodman and Aron, Q1 2026 Goodman twice.

statements.quote: This is why the box office does not need to fully recover to pre-pandemic levels for us to be able to achieve pre-pandemic levels of Adjusted EBITDA.
statements.speaker: Sean Goodman
statements.doc_title: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc. Q1 2026 Earnings Call

statements.quote: With so much zeal in cost management, our adjusted EBITDA margin jumped from 13.6% in last year's 2Q to 20.1% in the quarter just completed. This all demonstrates the inherent operating leverage in our business model, which is significant at a time of rising revenues.
statements.speaker: Adam Aron
statements.doc_title: AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc. Q2 2026 Earnings Call

street.gap_assumption: No margin level or year stated. The implicit dollar ambition (pre-pandemic Adjusted EBITDA, VA FY2019 $771.4M) compares with FY2027 consensus EBITDA $768.5M (0.4% below) and FY2028 $867.0M (above); the street already models it. Calendar fiscal year, so Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years.

evidence_of_progress.note: Q1 2026 adj EBITDA $38.3M on $1,045.4M revenue vs -$58.0M on $862.5M (VA actuals): +1,039 bps. Q2 2026 adj EBITDA margin 20.1% vs 13.6% (Aron, doc 41774): +650 bps. Box office driven operating leverage, not a management reset. VA has not yet loaded Q2 2026 actuals; LTM uses Aron's $321.4M and revenue derived as 321.4/0.201.

disqualifier_reason: No CEO or CFO change in the 18-month window and none pending (Aron CEO since 2016-01-04, Goodman CFO); the pre-pandemic EBITDA ambition is already in FY2027-28 consensus, and 4-month forward EBITDA revision is +10.8% (already re-rating).
verdict: Cheap and beaten down, but no leadership catalyst, no numeric margin target, and estimates are rising with the box office; not a GXO setup.
open_questions: How much of the 2026 margin gain survives a weaker 2027 film slate?
Does net debt of about 4.8x LTM EBITDA (data_comps) constrain the equity regardless of margin?
Will management ever convert the pre-pandemic EBITDA language into a dated margin target?
